name: aasb-aas-saas-launch-revenue
description: Install the "AAS SaaS Launch & Revenue" workflow plugin from Agentic Awesome Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Launch, price, monetize, measure, and grow SaaS products from MVP to revenue loops.
interface.longDescription: Launch, price, monetize, measure, and grow SaaS products from MVP to revenue loops. Connect MVP scope, pricing, payments and launch assets into a concrete launch-readiness review. Recommended for: Founders, Product teams, Growth-minded builders. Not for: Acquisition content as the main task: use Marketing, SEO & Growth, Guaranteed revenue or fabricated customer validation. Covers SaaS Mvp Launcher, Micro SaaS Launcher, and 8 more skills.
defaultPrompt: Review this SaaS product, audience and stage. Produce a launch-readiness plan covering MVP scope, pricing, payment failure cases and lifecycle assets. Use supplied evidence for revenue assumptions and separate implementation, launch preparation and actions requiring publication approval.
Use this plugin to review this pricing page and activation funnel for revenue opportunities.
Use this plugin to build a launch checklist with referral, email, analytics, and Stripe readiness.
